title: Member of Technical Staff 3 (QA+ System Testing+ Scalability+ Performance + Kubernetes)4–6 years
description:
**The Opportunity**
 Nutanix, a leader in enterprise hybrid cloud, is looking to hire a curious and innovative SDET with experience in automation development and execution to qualify our Data Hub product/features. The role is tasked with test planning, test case development, and test execution strategy to assess and improve the overall quality of our products in the AI/ML area. This requires close collaboration with Development, UI/UX engineers, and the PM team. The role encompasses influencing product design by leveraging broad knowledge of the product portfolio and ensuring a quality\-first mindset.
   

  

**Nutanix Data Hub (NDH) team**
 Nutanix Data Hub (NDH) offers our customers simplicity and ease of use to build and grow their AI/ML adoption faster and realize rapid ROI, by providing intelligent operations, self service and orchestration, visibility and governance of spend, security and teams, all through a unified Multi\-cloud management solution. The AI/ML platform ensures that any enterprise data used by AI systems is clean, safe, compliant, and reliable. The system should manage the complete AI data lifecycle, including ingestion, curation, governance, quality, and delivery to AI systems. The end goal of the system is that all data must pass permission checks, quality validation, and PII sanitization before entering vector databases (for performing semantic searches) or for Large Language Model (LLM) training. NDH also enhances financial accountability, offering cost governance, resource optimization, and clear cloud metering and chargeback visibility. Moreover, it unifies security operations across clouds, automating incident response through intelligent analysis and compliance tools.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Develop test plan design and test case development for performance, load \& scale testing of NDH products.
* Define automation plan and test strategy within release timelines.
* End\-to\-end product quality ownership with all aspects of the test, automation, and delivery of the feature set at scale.
* Improve existing automated tests and overall automated test execution efficiency.
* Maintain a high overall quality index(QI) for the product/features at all times.
* Ability to delve deeper into debugging product issues with development engineers.
* Involve providing active feedback to improve the overall product experience.
* Debugging, filing bugs, and tracking them to closure.


**What Will You Bring**
* Minimum of 4\+yrs\-7yrs of experience in QA(System Test), Automation using Python (python preferred)
* BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent field.
* In depth working knowledge of Linux system interactions and Distributed Systems
* Deeper understanding of SW platform performance, load, scaling features.
* Deeper understanding of KS8 platform performance, load, scaling features.
* Experience with Python API test framework development.
* Working knowledge of virtualization \- VMware, KVM, or Hyper\-V
* Familiarity with version control systems such as GIT, build management tools, and Continuous Integration tools such as Jenkins/CircleCI
* Testing experience with monitoring/cloud products is a plus
* Detail\-oriented, self\-driven, and good verbal and written communication skills.


**Meet the hiring manager**
 Hello, this is Subu TK! I joined Nutanix almost 10 years ago and worked with several teams and roles during this time. I had been tech lead for the Nutanix Files QA team for several years, before taking over the responsibility of managing and owning the NDH QA team end\-to\-end. During my tenure at Nutanix, I got a wonderful opportunity to qualify/automate several key projects starting from NFS Server, SMB Server, RBAC, API, and Tiering. Also I was involved in defining CICD workflow and building tools to automate the entire process. Our team comprises versatile skill set expertise, full of energetic, and fun filled professional engineers. We are actively working on scaling up the NDH features and the Team. Looking forward to hiring a highly collaborative, skillful, curious, innovative and motivated engineer to automate/qualify product releases with very high quality to delight our customers.
   

  

**What The Team Says**
 Our team is a highly collaborative, skilled, and friendly group of engineers who foster a culture of learning, knowledge sharing and ownership. This creates an environment where any problem can be solved efficiently and effectively. Several innovative solutions are built in our automation code that brings out more efficiency to the overall qualification process. Along the way it provides a lot of renewed opportunity for professional development, growth and a sense of achievement.
   

  

**Work Arrangement**
 Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

**About The Role**
 The Professional Services Consultant is a hybrid role based out of our Pune offie location. The role works across four areas of PS work, depending on where demand is highest in a given week: helping prospects get value from their free trial, supporting implementation and onboarding, hands\-on technical consulting work across integrations and data migrations, and delivering managed admin services to our client base.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Trial \& Conversion Support**
* Monitor active trial accounts and proactively help prospects reach a meaningful setup milestone before the trial expires
* Provide lightweight, unsolicited setup help — configuration tips, content upload assistance, quick walkthroughs
* Flag high\-intent trial accounts to Sales for follow\-up


**Onboarding \& Implementation Support**
* Support Activate and Operate implementations the way a Customer Enablement Specialist would — user setup, content configuration, admin training
* Log CEM hours against fixed\-fee projects consistent with existing project tracking
* Help customers reach go\-live readiness on schedule


**Technical Consulting**
* Build, configure, and monitor integrations — SFTP, API\-based connectors, and Platform Connector (LPC) work
* Support data migration projects, including field mapping and validation
* Custom coding work: CSS and JavaScript for branding, portal customization, and configuration beyond standard options


**Managed Admin Execution**
* Identify accounts that need help with their administration, establish their managed\-admin needs, and help bring customers back on track with their Litmos set up, workflows and processes.
* Document value delivered to support the renewal/upsell conversation the CEM or AE ultimately owns
* Maintain all documentation in Salesforce


**What Good Looks Like**
* Trial accounts reach a meaningful setup milestone well before expiration, and conversion rate improves against baseline
* Implementation projects supported stay on schedule with clean go\-live readiness
* Technical consulting work (integrations, migrations, custom coding) meets the same quality bar as the existing one\-time consultant team
* A measurable share of at\-risk accounts convert to a paid Managed Admin package at or ahead of renewal


**Requirements**
**Technical**
* Working proficiency in CSS and JavaScript for portal customization and branding work
* Experience with API\-based integrations and data migration projects
* Comfortable scoping and configuring technical work with the same rigor as a senior consultant, not just executing a checklist


**Customer\-Facing \& Process**
* 3–5 years in customer\-facing SaaS support, implementation, onboarding, or renewals
* Comfortable working from data signals (usage, engagement, trial activity) rather than only inbound requests
* Familiarity with LMS administration; Litmos experience strongly preferred
* Salesforce Planhat proficiency for logging project hours, gift tracking, and trial engagement
* Understands scope boundaries across all four functions — this role executes and prepares, it does not own customer relationships or make commercial decisions


**Salary Range:**

title: Senior ML Platform Engineer
description:
**Sr. Engineer – AI Data Platform \| ML Infrastructure \& Evaluation** 




**Location: Viman Nagar, Pune (Hybrid 3 days)** 




**Experience: 7\+ years** 




  





 We are looking for a Senior Engineer to build and operate ML infrastructure focused on model evaluation, regression detection, observability, and production AI monitoring.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 You will work on the engineering systems that evaluate AI models, identify model and pipeline regressions before production, monitor model behavior after deployment, and provide measurable signals around accuracy, reliability, drift, and inference cost.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Build and maintain a three\-tier ML evaluation framework covering component\-level benchmarking, end\-to\-end pipeline evaluation, and longitudinal performance analysis.
 



 • Manage versioned test sets and implement regression detection for model and pipeline changes.
 



 • Maintain and improve multimodal AI evaluation and debugging infrastructure.
 



 • Build and operate production model observability using monitoring, tracing, alerting, and performance signals.
 



 • Instrument training and inference pipelines to make model behavior measurable end to end.
 



 • Build and maintain drift detection, false\-positive management, confidence scoring, and model\-quality monitoring pipelines.
 



 • Implement regression testing that identifies differences between household\-specific performance and aggregate benchmarks.
 



 • Build cost monitoring for ML workloads and identify factors affecting inference cost, latency, and model performance.
 



 • Investigate model\-quality issues and contribute to root\-cause analysis and platform health reporting.
 



 • Work with Computer Vision, AI Platform, and Agentic AI teams to define evaluation and observability requirements for new model generations.
 



 • Contribute to code reviews, automated testing, engineering standards, and ML infrastructure design practices.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 • 5\+ years of software engineering experience with strong production\-quality Python skills.
 



 • Hands\-on experience building or operating ML infrastructure, MLOps, model evaluation, monitoring, or observability systems.
 



 • Experience building or operating model evaluation or regression\-detection systems in production.
 



 • Strong understanding of the ML lifecycle: training → evaluation → deployment → monitoring.
 



 • Experience with production ML platforms and real operational constraints.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with tools such as MLflow, Weights \& Biases/Weave, Datadog, or equivalent platforms.
 



 • Strong understanding of automated testing, system design, code reviews, and production software engineering.
 



  





**Good to Have** 




 • Computer Vision, Video AI, VLM, LLM evaluation, or multimodal AI experience.
 



 • Experience with video or event\-based AI pipelines.
 



 • Experience with model monitoring, drift detection, model serving, or inference optimization.
 



 • Experience with IoT, smart\-home, connected devices, robotics, or consumer technology products.
 



 • AWS ML experience or AWS Machine Learning certification.

* : Responsibility for the test execution/management of mass transit or main line rollouts of Interlocking (IxL) projects for CBTC/ Non\-CBTC signaling Systems as part of large\-scale railway infrastructure projects. Ensuring economic success and (internal) customer satisfaction for IxL domain in CBTC/ Non\-CBTC application projects Carrying responsibility for the lab data testing scope. Representation of the Test Team within a project when communicating to internal stakeholders, whilst reporting to the line management (test manager/group lead). + Responsible for data lab testing of IxL Sub\-systems in Test lab using real and simulated test environments.
+ Review / verification of all documents related to Lab data testing.
+ Evaluation of project, customer, rolling stock and internal requirements towards executing suitable project specific test cases and test documentation.
+ Detailed knowhow on functional aspects of IxL and its interface with other subsystems like ATC and ATS with CBTC/non\-CBTC.

title: Sr. Engineer Reliability Engineering XI
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Sr. Engineer – Reliability Engineering will be responsible for managing and executing
 **product reliability testing and validation activities within the Reliability Lab** 
 . The role will ensure that products, components, and systems meet defined reliability, durability, performance, and quality requirements through structured testing, data analysis, failure investigation, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 The role will work closely with
 **Product Design, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross\-functional teams** 
 to plan and execute reliability tests, identify failure modes, determine root causes, and recommend design or process improvements.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Plan, coordinate, and execute reliability, durability, life\-cycle, and qualification testing in the Reliability Lab.
* Develop test plans, test procedures, test setups, and test schedules based on product and customer requirements.
* Operate and ensure proper utilization of reliability laboratory equipment, test rigs, instrumentation, and data\-acquisition systems.
* Conduct reliability testing under thermal, mechanical, electrical, environmental, and other relevant stress conditions.
* Monitor tests, capture test data, identify abnormalities, and ensure timely escalation of test failures.
* Perform detailed analysis of test failures and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, 8D, and corrective actions.
* Work with Design Engineering to investigate failures and recommend design improvements to enhance product reliability.
* Ensure proper documentation of test results, observations, failures, corrective actions, and final conclusions.
* Prepare test reports, reliability reports, qualification reports, and technical presentations for engineering and leadership teams.
* Support new product development by providing reliability inputs during design verification and validation (DV/PV) activities.
* Support qualification and validation of design changes, components, materials, and suppliers.
* Ensure calibration and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment and test infrastructure.
* Maintain laboratory standards, safety requirements, testing protocols, and documentation.
* Coordinate with external laboratories and testing agencies whenever specialized testing is required.
* Analyze reliability data and identify trends, recurring failures, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support development and improvement of reliability test methodologies and laboratory capabilities.
* Mentor junior engineers/technicians on reliability testing, instrumentation, data analysis, and troubleshooting.


 Key Technical Skills
   

  

* Strong knowledge of Reliability Engineering and Reliability Testing.
* Hands\-on experience with reliability and environmental testing.
* Knowledge of FMEA, FTA, RCA, 8D, Weibull analysis, life testing, and accelerated life testing.
* Understanding of thermal, mechanical, electrical, and environmental stress testing.
* Experience with data acquisition systems, sensors, instrumentation, and test equipment.
* Ability to troubleshoot test setups and identify test\-system vs. product failures.
* Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.
* Knowledge of relevant industry/testing standards and engineering practices.
* Good understanding of product design and manufacturing processes.
* Strong technical documentation and reporting skills.


 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related Engineering discipline.
* Typically 5–8 years of relevant experience in Reliability Engineering, Product Validation, Testing, or Engineering Laboratory functions.
* Hands\-on experience working in a Reliability/Test/Validation Lab is preferred.
* Experience in HVAC, thermal management, cooling systems, data\-center equipment, power electronics, or similar engineered products will be an advantage.


 Key Competencies
   

  

* Reliability \& Failure Analysis
* Laboratory \& Test Management
* Technical Problem Solving
* Data Analysis
* Root Cause Analysis
* Product Testing \& Validation
* Project Ownership
* Cross\-functional Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Technical Documentation
* Decision Making


 Key KPIs
   

  

* On\-time completion of reliability and qualification testing
* Reliability test execution quality and accuracy
* Reduction in repeat/recurring test failures
* Timely identification and closure of reliability issues
* Effectiveness of RCA and corrective actions

title: Data Quality Officer
description:
**About The Role**
**As a
 **Data Quality Officer for HR \& Reference Data** 
 , you will be the key enabler in maximizing the value and trustworthiness of our most critical enterprise domains: our workforce information and core reference datasets.**
**You will act as a proactive partner, collaborating closely with business and technical teams. A critical part of your role is bridging perspectives—from HR business partners to IT architects—into clear, actionable data analysis.**
**Your mission is to resolve data issues and nurture a proactive prevention mindset across the organization. You will translate HR processes and Reference Data requirements into formal data quality policies, rules, and governance standards. By storylining data health metrics and serving as a data provocateur when needed, you will drive the continuous improvement of our core data foundation.**
****Key Responsibilities****
* Domain\-Specific Insight Generation \& Profiling:
+ Perform deep\-dive root cause analysis on HR datasets (e.g., employee lifecycle, payroll interfaces, org structures) and Reference Data (e.g., enterprise code tables, locations, job classifications, cost centers) to isolate systemic, process, or integration issues.
+ Conduct thorough data profiling on critical master and reference datasets to detect anomalies, cross\-system discrepancies, orphan records, and data drift.
+ Document findings and quantify the business impact of poor data quality on operational HR, compliance, reporting, and downstream integrations.

* Stakeholder Collaboration \& Standard Setting:
+ Work closely with HR Data Stewards, Data Governance, and IT to define, document, and enforce clear data quality rules and reference data standards.
+ Translate HR business rules and Reference Data governance policies into precise technical specifications for automated validation and monitoring tools.
+ Act as the primary liaison between business domain owners and technical teams, ensuring alignment on data lineage and data definitions.

* Monitoring, Reporting \& Governance:
+ Maintain domain\-specific Data Quality Dashboards (e.g., tracking HR data completeness, reference data synchronization) for clear visibility across business units.
+ Track and report HR and Reference Data quality KPIs to leadership, driving transparency and accountability.
+ Support reference data management processes, ensuring code values, mappings, and taxonomies remain synchronized across target applications.

* Remediation \& Prevention:
+ Collaborate with IT and HR Tech teams to define requirements for data cleansing, automated enrichment, and exception management.
+ Support business teams at the point of data entry/creation to improve source data quality and minimize manual workarounds.


****Your Profile****
* Boundary Spanner: Ability to connect HR business processes and enterprise reference data structures with backend technical architectures.
* Influencer \& Storyteller: Skilled at translating complex data anomalies into compelling narratives for HR leadership and business managers.
* Collaborator: A strong team player dedicated to building cross\-functional alignment across HR Operations, Enterprise Data Management/Governance, and IT.
* Mindset: Detail\-oriented, persistent, and proactive about driving data transparency and operational excellence.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, HR Analytics, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience as a Data Quality Officer, Data Governance Analyst, or Data Steward, with direct experience handling HR data, Master Data Management (MDM), or Reference Data domains.
* Essential: Strong proficiency in SQL for complex data querying, profiling, and joining datasets across multi\-table environments.
* Hands\-on experience with modern HR Information Systems (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM) and Reference Data concepts (code lists, hierarchies, mapping tables).
* Fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with global teams.


**Preferred Skills**
* Familiarity with Data Governance frameworks (Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Data Cataloging).
* Experience using scripting languages (e.g., Python) for automated data checks or profiling is a plus.
* Knowledge of global HR data privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, local DPDP regulations).

title: SW QA Engineer
description:
We are seeking an Advanced SW Quality Assurance Engineer who can own complex QA modules, design scalable automation solutions, guide team members, and ensure quality across web, mobile, API, and microservices\-based applications. The role requires strong technical depth in automation frameworks, system integration testing, CI/CD integration, and Agile delivery practices.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own QA delivery for complex modules, features, and product areas across web, mobile, API, and microservices\-based applications; define automation approaches for functional, regression, integration, API, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Design, develop, enhance, and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Java or C\#; lead system integration testing across distributed and microservices\-based environments.
* Integrate and optimize automated test execution within CI/CD pipelines preferably using GitLab; collaborate with architects, developers, product owners, Scrum masters, and QA stakeholders to define test strategies, estimates, and release quality criteria.
* Review automation code, improve test stability, reduce flakiness, and promote reusable automation design patterns; guide and mentor team members on automation best practices, BDD implementation, API testing, test data handling, and defect analysis.
* Create and maintain QA documentation including test plans, test designs, defect reports, release notes, and automation guidelines; ensure quality processes align with delivery and release objectives.
* Leverage AI/GenAI tools to accelerate automation development, debugging, documentation, impact analysis, onboarding, and test scenario generation; apply prompt engineering techniques to improve test coverage, edge case identification, automation quality, and debugging insights.
* Evaluate AI\-generated automation assets for correctness, maintainability, security, coverage, and alignment with QA strategy; contribute to adoption and effective usage of AI\-enabled QA platforms and MCP\-style integrations for intelligent automation and workflow optimization.


**What You’ll Bring**
 To Help You Succeed, We’ll Provide You With Everything You Need So That We’re Driving Impact Together From Day One. Here’s What You’ll Need To Bring With You
   

  

* 8\+ years of experience in software testing and quality engineering with strong expertise in test automation; hands\-on experience using Java or C\# for designing and developing automation frameworks.
* Strong expertise in Selenium for web automation and Appium for mobile automation; hands\-on experience with BDD frameworks such as Cucumber, SpecFlow, or Reqnroll.
* Strong API testing experience using Postman along with RestAssured or RestSharp; experience in system integration and end\-to\-end testing for microservices\-based applications.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines preferably using GitLab; strong knowledge of Agile Scrum methodologies and JIRA\-based test and defect management practices.
* Ability to guide developers and QA engineers on automation practices, test design, execution strategies, and defect triage; strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Practical experience leveraging AI/GenAI tools for test scenario creation, automation development, debugging, documentation, impact analysis, and test optimization; ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated QA outputs for correctness, reliability, maintainability, coverage, and quality.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled QA platforms (e.g., JIRA/Selenium MCP server or equivalent) for intelligent automation and workflow optimization; good to have experience with Zephyr, JMeter, Docker, AWS, SQL for database validation, and test automation governance.


**What’s In It for You**
**Benefits**
 We really value our people, and we’ve worked hard to develop a reward package that reflects this \- creating your future to be just how you would want it. Some of our benefits include:
   

  

* Become a valuable member of a highly professional and international team of software engineering and quality engineering experts.
* Work on challenging quality engineering problems for a global multinational company using modern technologies and engineering practices.
* Contribute to end\-to\-end product quality across test strategy, automation, system integration testing, CI/CD, and release readiness.
* Operate with ownership and accountability in your responsible area while collaborating with global product and engineering teams.
* Build your career in a dynamic environment with excellent opportunities to develop yourself to higher levels and broaden your technical knowledge.
* Benefit from a clearly defined career development track for every individual employee.
* Be part of a performance\-driven culture where strong contribution and impact are recognized and rewarded.
* Grow within an organization where a large percentage of senior and leadership positions are filled internally.


**Why Hilti**
 Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.
   

  

**Commitment to Inclusion**
 At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

description:
Senior QA Engineer
 



  





**Team:** 
 Healthcare EHR product engineering ·
 **Work model:** 
 WFO ( 5 days )·
 **Level:** 
 Senior individual contributor ·
 **Focus:** 
 test automation and AI\-augmented quality
 



  





 Role summary
 



  





 A senior QA engineer who builds automated test suites, embeds quality in an AI\-augmented (AI\-PDLC) delivery model, and drives the move from manual to automated testing for a healthcare EHR platform.
 



  





 Key responsibilities
 



  




* Build and maintain automated test suites (for example Playwright) integrated into CI/CD.
* Convert manual regression into reliable automated coverage on the critical paths.
* Embed in a squad: help write and refine acceptance criteria during the working session, and start testing as soon as the first build is ready.
* Use AI to generate tests, then validate that output rigorously — catching false positives and coverage gaps.
* Test AI\-backed product features: design evaluation checks for non\-deterministic behavior, including scenarios exercised from outside the code under test.
* Manage test data, including compliant synthetic data for a regulated (HIPAA) domain.



  





 Required skills and experience
 



  




* 5\+ years in software QA / test automation, with hands\-on framework build and maintenance (not only test execution).
* Proficiency with a modern automation framework (Playwright or equivalent, such as Selenium or Cypress) integrated into CI/CD.
* Programming for test automation in JavaScript/TypeScript or Python.
* Strong test strategy and risk\-based design, with fluency across API, UI, and integration testing.
* Hands\-on AI\-assisted or prompt\-driven test generation, plus the discipline to validate what the AI produces.
* Experience testing AI, machine\-learning, or LLM\-backed features — handling non\-determinism and designing evaluation/oracle checks such as golden sets and groundedness.
* A track record of converting manual regression into reliable automated coverage (shift\-left), working embedded in a cross\-functional team.



  





 Preferred qualifications (nice to have)
 



  




* ISTQB Foundation (CTFL) or AI Testing (CT\-AI) certification.
* Healthcare or other regulated\-domain testing, and synthetic test data (for example Synthea/FHIR).
* Performance testing, contract testing, or self\-healing test tooling.



  





 What a strong candidate looks like
 



  





 Has personally built automation up from a low baseline, can show AI\-assisted tests they wrote and then validated, and has tested at least one AI or machine\-learning feature with an evaluation harness rather than manual spot\-checks.
 



  





 Location and work model
 



  





 Hybrid, working within the product engineering team on its collaboration hours. This role is early in an automation\-first transition, so you will be building coverage from a modest baseline — a chance to set the standard rather than inherit it.
 



  





 Compensation
 



  





 Competitive compensation for a senior QA engineer, benchmarked to the local market. Specific range shared early in the process and in line with applicable pay\-transparency requirements.
 



 Equal opportunity and accommodation
 



 We are an equal\-opportunity employer and evaluate candidates on their ability to perform the essential functions of the role. We provide reasonable accommodation for applicants and employees with disabilities — please let us know if you need one during the process.

description:

**1\. Manual Testing Responsibilities**

* Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines
* Perform API testing
* Perform performance and load testing
* Analyze automation results and maintain dashboards


**3\. Test Planning \& Strategy (Senior Analyst Role)**
* Define test strategy (manual \+ automation mix)

* Participate in requirement reviews and risk analysis

* Track defect lifecycle: New → Assigned → Fixed → Retested → Closed

description:

**Job Title: SAP CML Test Engineer**
**Corporate Title:** 
**Assistant Vice President**
**Location: Pune, India**

* As an SAP CML Test Engineer, you will be a crucial member of our cross\-functional team, ensuring the quality, stability, and performance of our core Lending applications. You will leverage your expertise in both mortgages business processes and SAP CML to design, execute, and document comprehensive testing strategies. You will collaborate closely with Requirements Engineers, Developers and Application Managers in both Pune and Frankfurt to verify and secure the technology solutions that support Deutsche Bank's lending operations.
* The Lending Platforms team is a global unit responsible for the development, enhancement, and maintenance of Deutsche Bank's core lending systems. As a critical function within our Private Bank Technology division, we manage the lifecycle of loan products on the SAP CML (Consumer and Mortgage Loans) platform. Our team is strategically located in Frankfurt and Pune, fostering a collaborative, multinational environment to deliver robust and innovative solutions for our business partners.


**What We’ll Offer You**
 As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,
   

  

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Test Strategy and Planning: Deliver a strong contribution with the test team, which will develop, document, and maintain functional and non\-functional test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on business requirements and technical specifications.
* Test Execution: Execute manual and automated tests for SAP CML and integrated systems, covering all phases of testing including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Regression Testing.
* Defect Management: Identify, log, and track defects with precision. Collaborate with development teams to analyze root causes and ensure timely resolution and re\-testing.
* Domain Expertise: Apply your in\-depth knowledge of the mortgages business lifecycle (origination, servicing, closure) to create/manage realistic and effective test scenarios.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work in close partnership with a multi\-national team of Requirements Engineers, Developers and Application Managers across Pune and Frankfurt to ensure a shared understanding of requirements and quality standards.
* Reporting and Documentation: Contribute to providing clear, concise, and timely reporting on test progress, defect status, and overall quality to project stakeholders. Maintain comprehensive test documentation.
* Process Improvement: Contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing processes, methodologies, and tools.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* SAP CML Expertise: Proven, hands\-on experience in testing SAP Consumer and Mortgage Loans (CML) module. Strong understanding of CML configuration, processes, and integration points.
* Testing Proficiency: Minimum of 2\+ years in a dedicated software testing role with a strong grasp of QA methodologies, tools, and processes (STLC, SDLC).
* Mortgages Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of the end\-to\-end mortgage lending business process, from application and underwriting to servicing and securitization.
* Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed, multi\-national team environment across different time zones.
* Analytical Mindset: Analytical and problem\-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.


**Advantageous / Nice to Have**
* Test Management Tools: Familiarity with test management tools, particularly Tricentis Test, for planning and tracking test execution.
* Test Automation Tools: Hands\-on experience with test automation frameworks, especially Tricentis Tosca, for creating and maintaining automated test suites.
* Certifications: ISTQB/ISEB or other relevant software testing certifications.
* Agile Experience: Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.
* Broader SAP Knowledge: Experience with other SAP Banking Services modules (e.g., SAP BP, BCA) or FI/CO is a plus.
* German language skills: would be regarded as a plus point.


**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**
**How We’ll Support You**
* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

**Engineer – Product Testing(VAVE)**
**Job Description**
 Coordinate with design, production, procurement, and product testing teams to validate cost\-optimized solutions for existing and new products under VAVE (Value Analysis and Value Engineering) initiatives. The primary responsibility is to ensure reliability, functional integrity, and certification compliance after implementing VAVE changes. This role requires validating design and component modifications through structured testing, automation programs, and compliance assessments. Being part of a Global Engineering Function, the role demands strict adherence to defined processes and communication protocols.

* Build and configure MDM platform features across assigned domains

* Build stewardship workflows and business rules per design specifications

* Build and maintain custom data entry screens and validation rules per design specifications
* Execute data mapping and onboarding for new sources per established patterns
* Execute data migrations and bulk operations per migration plans
* Implement platform enhancements and optimizations

title: QA Engineer, Trading Systems
description:
QA Engineer, Trading Systems
 



  





**Location** 
 : Pune 
 



**Experience** 
 : 1 \- 3 years
 



**Engagement** 
 : Full\-time, in\-house
 



**Reports To** 
 : Head of Algo Trading / Founder
 



  





**About AJ Algo** 




  






 AJ Algo
 
 runs a portfolio of automated trading bots across Forex (MT4/MT5\), crypto exchanges, and equity/F\&O broker APIs. We build and operate systems that don't just generate trading signals, they execute them reliably, enforce risk discipline in code, and stay resilient around the clock. We're a small, hands\-on team where engineering rigor and calibrated scepticism matter as much as trading performance.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 You will own quality across our trading infrastructure, where bugs don't just break a feature, they can cost real money. Your job is to make sure every order, every risk check, and every model deployment has been genuinely tried to break before it touches a live account.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




 Test the full order lifecycle: signal generation, risk checks, order routing, fill confirmation, and position tracking
 



 Validate risk management logic: position sizing, daily loss limits, drawdown stops, and margin safeguards, including edge cases like non\-USD\-quoted symbols and correlated exposure
 



 Test failure scenarios explicitly: rejected orders, partial fills, requotes, slippage, disconnects, and stale prices
 



 Verify reconciliation logic between bot\-held positions and broker/exchange records
 



 Test across multiple venues (MT4/MT5, crypto exchange APIs, equity/F\&O broker APIs) and catch behaviour that doesn't generalise across them
 



 Build and maintain automated test suites for money\-touching code, including unit tests for risk calculations
 



 Test monitoring and alerting: confirm the right severity triggers the right alert, and that silent failures don't slip through
 



 Validate ML model deployments: check that walk\-forward or purged cross\-validation was used correctly, and that shadow to small\-allocation to full\-allocation rollouts are gated properly
 



 Test server and terminal recovery scenarios: restarts, reconnections, and failover, confirming positions are reconciled before new trading resumes
 



 Log clear, reproducible bugs with steps, expected versus actual, and evidence
 



 Own the release checklist and sign off before anything ships to a live trading account
 



  





**Must\-Haves** 




 Manual testing fundamentals: test cases, regression suites, bug reporting
 



 Hands\-on automation experience (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Python\-based test frameworks like pytest)
 



 API testing and comfort reading JSON responses; experience with Postman or similar
 



 Basic SQL for verifying trade and position data
 



 Comfort with financial/numerical edge cases: rounding, lot sizing, tick values, and precision errors
 



 Ability to work directly with developers rather than throwing bugs over a wall
 



 A conservative, sceptical mindset: comfortable blocking a release when something is ambiguous rather than assuming it's fine
 



  





**Good to Have** 




 Experience testing trading systems, fintech, or other money\-touching applications
 



 Familiarity with MT4/MT5, crypto exchange APIs, or broker APIs
 



 Understanding of basic risk management concepts (position sizing, stop losses, margin, leverage)
 



 Experience testing ML model outputs where results aren't identical on every run
 



 Running tests in a CI pipeline on every merge
 



 Basic performance or load testing, especially around latency\-sensitive execution paths
 



  





**Share Your Resume** 




 Interested candidates can share their resume with us at: admin@ajems.com
